packets.atomic_claim: The currently admitted G9 V3 research surface contains operators and conditional/coalescing forms not represented by the currently admitted grammar.
packets.verification_requirement: Real current parser executes complete admitted G9 corpus on Ubuntu.
packets.falsifier: Authoritative executable surface is a different corpus/grammar or parser already supports these forms via admitted semantics not reflected in grammar.

packets.atomic_claim: Sparse dependency-closure incremental recomputation can preserve exact synthetic results at far lower operation count than full recomputation.
packets.verification_requirement: Replay real Clay/UnifiedDB dependency graphs with bookkeeping cost included.
packets.falsifier: Real affected closures are dense or overhead erases the gain.

packets.atomic_claim: Set-intersection capability attenuation satisfies authority non-amplification in a simplified randomized verb-set model; runtime containment remains unproven.
packets.verification_requirement: Nested host/FFI/subprocess capability fuzz on Ubuntu with resource identity, revocation and ambient handles.
packets.falsifier: Any child obtains undeclared authority/effect absent an external grant.

packets.atomic_claim: WASM/WASI capability sandboxing should be treated as defense-in-depth rather than Clay's sole authority root because sandbox/runtime implementation defects can violate intended host restrictions.
packets.verification_requirement: Clay broker + WASI/native adapter escape regression suite.
packets.falsifier: A formally complete and verified backend mediation layer independently proves all relevant effect closure properties.

packets.atomic_claim: Adaptive recurrent depth should be tested for both useful refinement and overthinking; recurrence count alone is not a quality or emergence measure.
packets.verification_requirement: Matched FRANK frozen-episode fixed-vs-adaptive recurrence experiment with outcome/cost/stability metrics.
packets.falsifier: Fixed-depth/event-driven control Pareto-dominates adaptive recurrence across representative episodes.
